description: This file defines a class 'TlsServerAuthenticationOptions' which encapsulates and manages SSL/TLS server authentication settings, including certificate handling, protocol configuration, and callback mechanisms for a Orleans-based application.

classes.name: TlsServerAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates SSL/TLS server authentication settings for Orleans connections, providing properties to configure certificates, protocols, and callbacks.

methods.name: ServerCertificate
methods.description: Gets or sets the server's X509 certificate used for SSL/TLS authentication.

methods.name: ServerCertificateSelectionCallback
methods.description: Gets or sets the callback delegate for selecting the server certificate based on the hostname.

methods.name: ClientCertificateRequired
methods.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a client certificate is required.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSL protocols enabled for the connection.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the revocation mode for certificate validation.

methods.name: SslServerAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying SslServerAuthenticationOptions object.
